statement: Let P be a small generic input of size p, and let h, h′ be linked labels at P. Let C1, . . . , Cs be small generic inputs of sizes in S, jointly independent with P, where s = 0 is allowed. Put R = diag(P, C1, . . . , Cs). Over a common spectral splitting field E, denote by ΛR j (∆) the scalar eigenvalue branch of W(R + ∆) whose value at zero is λj(P), for j = h, h′. Define gj(η) = λj(P + ηv) − λj(P) ∈ ΩP [[η]], j = h, h′ . Then g′ h′ (0) ̸= 0, and ΛR h (∆) − λh(P) = (︁ gh ◦ g−1 h′ )︁(︁ ΛR h′ (∆) − λh′ (P) )︁ . (7.2) Here g−1 h′ denotes the inverse for composition. In particular, the univariate series in this identity depends only on P, h, h′ and v, and is unchanged when auxiliary blocks are adjoined.
